import { randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { getCookie, setCookie } from 'hono/cookie';
import { bodyLimit } from 'hono/body-limit';
import { serveStatic } from '@hono/node-server/serve-static';
import { CatalogError } from './types.js';
import { preparationInput, preparationId, preparedAnswerInput, questionFields, serializedQuestionReview, preparedQuestionError } from './prepared-question-api.js';
import { declarationMap } from './system-map.js';
import { codeFlows } from './code-flows.js';
import { Corrections } from './corrections.js';
import { indexChanges } from './index-changes.js';
import { Reconciliation } from './reconciliation.js';
import { projectOrientation } from './orientation.js';
import { sourceCandidatePreview } from './source-candidates.js';
import { lookupCodeSymbols } from './code-symbols.js';
import { pathRequest } from './code-paths.js';
import { CodePathsV2 } from './code-paths-v2.js';
import { OperationBudgetError } from './operation-budget.js';
import { NativeCaptures } from './native-capture.js';
import { captureSelection, historyReceiptId, nativeCaptureError, captureListSelection } from './native-capture-api.js';
export function createApp(catalog, options = {}) {
    const preparations = options.preparations;
    if (preparations && (!options.answers || options.answers.catalog !== catalog || !preparations.ownsStore(catalog.store)))
        throw new CatalogError('INVALID_PREPARATION_OWNER', 'Prepared questions require this catalog’s answer and preparation services.', 409);
    const app = new Hono();
    const hosts = new Set(['127.0.0.1:4244', ...options.development ? ['127.0.0.1:5174'] : []]);
    const origins = new Set([...hosts].map(host => `http://${host}`));
    const sessions = new Map();
    app.use('*', async (c, next) => {
        if (c.req.path === '/api' || c.req.path.startsWith('/api/'))
            c.header('Cache-Control', 'no-store');
        if (!hosts.has(c.req.header('host') ?? ''))
            return c.json({ error: { message: 'Use the local LoreDock URL.' } }, 403);
        const origin = c.req.header('origin');
        const navigation = c.req.method === 'GET' && c.req.path !== '/api' && !c.req.path.startsWith('/api/')
            && c.req.header('sec-fetch-mode') === 'navigate' && c.req.header('sec-fetch-dest') === 'document'
            && c.req.header('sec-fetch-user') === '?1' && origin === undefined;
        if ((origin !== undefined && !origins.has(origin)) || (c.req.header('sec-fetch-site') === 'cross-site' && !navigation))
            return c.json({ error: { message: 'Cross-origin requests are not allowed.' } }, 403);
        c.header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
        c.header('X-Frame-Options', 'DENY');
        c.header('Referrer-Policy', 'no-referrer');
        if (!options.development)
            c.header('Content-Security-Policy', "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'");
        await next();
    });
    app.use('/api/*', bodyLimit({ maxSize: 16384, onError: c => c.json({ error: { message: 'Request exceeds 16 KiB.' } }, 413) }));
    app.use('/api/*', async (c, next) => {
        for (const [id, session] of sessions)
            if (session.expires <= Date.now())
                sessions.delete(id);
        if (c.req.path === '/api/health' && c.req.method === 'GET')
            return next();
        if (c.req.path === '/api/session' && c.req.method === 'POST') {
            if (!origins.has(c.req.header('origin') ?? '') || c.req.header('x-loredock-client') !== 'web')
                return c.json({ error: { message: 'Open LoreDock in your browser.' } }, 403);
            return next();
        }
        const session = sessions.get(getCookie(c, 'loredock_session') ?? '');
        if (!session)
            return c.json({ error: { message: 'Reload to reconnect to LoreDock.' } }, 401);
        if (!['GET', 'HEAD'].includes(c.req.method)) {
            const token = Buffer.from(c.req.header('x-loredock-csrf') ?? ''), expected = Buffer.from(session.token);
            if (!origins.has(c.req.header('origin') ?? '') || token.length !== expected.length || !timingSafeEqual(token, expected))
                return c.json({ error: { message: 'The request could not be verified.' } }, 403);
        }
        await next();
    });
    app.get('/api/health', c => c.json({ service: 'loredock', version: '0.1.0', modelExecution: Boolean(options.answers), codeAnalysis: Boolean(options.codeAnalysis) }));
    app.post('/api/session', c => {
        const existing = sessions.get(getCookie(c, 'loredock_session') ?? '');
        if (existing)
            return c.json({ token: existing.token });
        if (sessions.size >= 64)
            return c.json({ error: { message: 'Too many browser sessions.' } }, 429);
        const id = randomBytes(32).toString('hex'), token = randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
        sessions.set(id, { token, expires: Date.now() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000 });
        setCookie(c, 'loredock_session', id, { httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'Strict', path: '/api', maxAge: 28800 });
        return c.json({ token });
    });
    const body = async (request) => {
        let value;
        try {
            value = await request.json();
        }
        catch {
            throw new CatalogError('INVALID_JSON', 'A JSON object is required.');
        }
        if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value))
            throw new CatalogError('INVALID_JSON', 'A JSON object is required.');
        return value;
    };
    app.get('/api/project', c => c.json(catalog.state()));
    app.post('/api/sources', async (c) => {
        const input = await body(c.req);
        if (typeof input.path !== 'string' || input.path.length > 4096)
            throw new CatalogError('INVALID_PATH', 'Enter an absolute local repository path.');
        return c.json(await catalog.addSource(input.path), 201);
    });
    app.post('/api/sources/preview', async (c) => c.json(await catalog.previewSources((await body(c.req)).paths)));
    app.post('/api/sources/register', async (c) => c.json(await catalog.registerSources(await body(c.req)), 201));
    app.post('/api/sources/:id/revoke', c => { catalog.revoke(c.req.param('id')); return c.json(catalog.state()); });
    app.put('/api/policy', async (c) => { const input = await body(c.req); catalog.updatePolicy(input.excludedPaths); return c.json(catalog.state()); });
    app.post('/api/builds', async (c) => {
        const input = await body(c.req);
        if (typeof input.requestId !== 'string' || !Number.isSafeInteger(input.sourceSetVersion) || !Number.isSafeInteger(input.policyVersion))
            throw new CatalogError('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Request ID and current source/policy versions are required.');
        return c.json(catalog.start(input.requestId, input.sourceSetVersion, input.policyVersion), 202);
    });
    app.get('/api/builds/:id', c => c.json(catalog.store.build(c.req.param('id'))));
    app.get('/api/builds/:id/files', c => c.json({ files: catalog.files(c.req.param('id')), limit: 100 }));
    app.get('/api/builds/:id/changes', c => c.json(indexChanges(catalog, c.req.param('id'))));
    app.post('/api/builds/:id/:action', c => c.json(catalog.control(c.req.param('id'), c.req.param('action'))));
    app.get('/api/search', c => c.json(catalog.search(c.req.query('q') ?? '', c.req.query('buildId'))));
    app.get('/api/evidence/:id', c => c.json(catalog.evidence(c.req.param('id'))));
    app.get('/api/system-map', c => c.json(declarationMap(catalog, c.req.query('buildId'))));
    app.get('/api/code-flows', c => c.json(codeFlows(catalog, c.req.query('buildId'))));
    app.get('/api/orientation', c => c.json(projectOrientation(catalog, c.req.query('buildId'))));
    const codeAnalysis = options.codeAnalysis;
    if (codeAnalysis) {
        const codePaths = options.codePaths ?? new CodePathsV2(codeAnalysis);
        const nativeCaptures = options.nativeCaptures ?? new NativeCaptures(codeAnalysis, { paths: codePaths });
        app.get('/api/path-captures', async (c) => {
            const selection = captureListSelection(new URL(c.req.url).searchParams, c.req.raw.headers);
            return c.json(await nativeCaptures.list(selection, c.req.raw.signal));
        });
        app.post('/api/path-captures', async (c) => {
            const selection = captureSelection(new URL(c.req.url).searchParams, await c.req.text());
            const result = await nativeCaptures.capture(selection, c.req.raw.signal);
            return c.json(result, result.created ? 201 : 200);
        });
        app.get('/api/path-captures/:receiptId', async (c) => {
            const id = historyReceiptId(c.req.param('receiptId'), new URL(c.req.url).searchParams, c.req.raw.headers);
            return c.json(await nativeCaptures.history(id, c.req.raw.signal));
        });
        app.get('/api/code-paths', async (c) => c.json(await codePaths.read(pathRequest(new URL(c.req.url).searchParams, 'paths'), 'paths', c.req.raw.signal)));
        app.get('/api/code-paths/roots', async (c) => c.json(await codePaths.read(pathRequest(new URL(c.req.url).searchParams, 'roots'), 'roots', c.req.raw.signal)));
        app.get('/api/code-symbols', async (c) => c.json(await lookupCodeSymbols(codeAnalysis, c.req.query('q') ?? '', c.req.query('buildId'))));
        app.get('/api/code-analysis', c => c.json(options.codeFollow?.state() ?? { inventories: codeAnalysis.list(), pendingBuildId: null, automaticError: null }));
        app.post('/api/code-analysis', async (c) => {
            const input = await body(c.req), project = catalog.store.project();
            if (Object.keys(input).some(key => !['requestId', 'buildId', 'policyVersion', 'sourceSetVersion'].includes(key))
                || typeof input.requestId !== 'string' || typeof input.buildId !== 'string' || !input.buildId || input.buildId.length > 100
                || !Number.isSafeInteger(input.policyVersion) || !Number.isSafeInteger(input.sourceSetVersion)) {
                throw new CatalogError('INVALID_REQUEST', 'A request ID, published index and current source/policy versions are required.');
            }
            if (input.policyVersion !== project.policyVersion || input.sourceSetVersion !== project.sourceSetVersion
                || catalog.readBuild(input.buildId).sourceSetVersion !== project.sourceSetVersion) {
                throw new CatalogError('CONFLICT', 'Sources or policy changed. Update knowledge before analyzing code.', 409);
            }
            return c.json(codeAnalysis.start(input.requestId, input.buildId), 202);
        });
        app.get('/api/code-analysis/:id/files', c => {
            const offset = c.req.query('offset');
            if (offset !== undefined && !/^(0|[1-9]\d{0,4})$/.test(offset))
                throw new CatalogError('INVALID_PAGE', 'Choose an available code-file page.');
            return c.json({ files: codeAnalysis.files(c.req.param('id'), offset === undefined ? 0 : Number(offset)), offset: offset === undefined ? 0 : Number(offset), limit: 50 });
        });
        app.get('/api/code-analysis/:id/files/:fileId', c => c.json(codeAnalysis.file(c.req.param('id'), c.req.param('fileId'))));
        app.post('/api/code-analysis/:id/:action', async (c) => {
            const text = await c.req.text();
            if (text.trim()) {
                let input;
                try {
                    input = JSON.parse(text);
                }
                catch {
                    throw new CatalogError('INVALID_JSON', 'Code analysis controls take no arguments.');
                }
                if (!input || typeof input !== 'object' || Array.isArray(input) || Object.keys(input).length)
                    throw new CatalogError('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Code analysis controls take no arguments.');
            }
            const action = c.req.param('action');
            if (action !== 'pause' && action !== 'resume' && action !== 'cancel')
                throw new CatalogError('INVALID_ACTION', 'Unknown code analysis action.');
            return c.json(codeAnalysis.control(c.req.param('id'), action));
        });
    }
    app.post('/api/candidates/preview', async (c) => {
        const input = await body(c.req);
        if (Object.keys(input).some(key => key !== 'question' && key !== 'buildId' && key !== 'relatedOffset') || typeof input.question !== 'string'
            || (input.buildId !== undefined && typeof input.buildId !== 'string')) {
            throw new CatalogError('INVALID_REQUEST', 'A question and optional index version are required.');
        }
        return c.json(sourceCandidatePreview(catalog, input.question, input.buildId, input.relatedOffset));
    });
    const corrections = new Corrections(catalog);
    app.get('/api/corrections', c => c.json(corrections.list(c.req.query('buildId'))));
    app.get('/api/corrections/:id/history', c => c.json(corrections.history(c.req.param('id'))));
    app.post('/api/corrections', async (c) => c.json(corrections.save(await body(c.req)), 201));
    const reconciliation = new Reconciliation(catalog);
    app.get('/api/correction-reconciliation', c => c.json(reconciliation.preview(c.req.query('buildId'), c.req.query('fromBuildId'))));
    app.post('/api/corrections/reapply', async (c) => c.json(reconciliation.reapply(await body(c.req)), 201));
    const answers = options.answers;
    if (answers) {
        app.get('/api/answers', c => c.json({ ...answers.state(), ...preparations ? { preparedQuestions: true } : {} }));
        if (preparations) {
            app.post('/api/question-preparations', async (c) => {
                const input = preparationInput(await body(c.req), catalog.store.project().publishedBuildId);
                return c.json(preparations.start(input.requestId, input.question), 202);
            });
            app.get('/api/question-preparations/:id', c => c.json(preparations.get(preparationId(c.req.param('id')))));
            app.get('/api/question-preparations/:id/review', c => c.body(serializedQuestionReview(preparations.review(preparationId(c.req.param('id')))), 200, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }));
            app.post('/api/question-preparations/:id/cancel', async (c) => {
                questionFields(await body(c.req), []);
                return c.json(preparations.cancel(preparationId(c.req.param('id'))));
            });
            app.post('/api/prepared-answers', async (c) => {
                const input = preparedAnswerInput(await body(c.req));
                return c.json(answers.startPrepared(input.requestId, input.preparationId, input.reviewedHash), 202);
            });
        }
        app.put('/api/answers/configuration', async (c) => c.json(await answers.configure(await body(c.req))));
        app.post('/api/answers/preview', async (c) => {
            const input = await body(c.req);
            if (typeof input.question !== 'string' || (input.buildId !== undefined && typeof input.buildId !== 'string'))
                throw new CatalogError('INVALID_REQUEST', 'A question and optional index version are required.');
            return c.json(answers.preview(input.question, input.buildId));
        });
        app.post('/api/answers', async (c) => {
            const input = await body(c.req);
            if (![input.requestId, input.question, input.buildId, input.inputHash].every(value => typeof value === 'string'))
                throw new CatalogError('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Request ID and reviewed question context are required.');
            return c.json(answers.start(input.requestId, input.question, input.buildId, input.inputHash), 202);
        });
        app.get('/api/answers/:id', c => c.json(answers.get(c.req.param('id'))));
        app.post('/api/answers/:id/cancel', c => c.json(answers.cancel(c.req.param('id'))));
    }
    app.all('/api', c => c.json({ error: { message: 'Unknown API route.' } }, 404));
    app.all('/api/*', c => c.json({ error: { message: 'Unknown API route.' } }, 404));
    if (options.publicDir && existsSync(path.join(options.publicDir, 'index.html'))) {
        app.use('/*', serveStatic({ root: options.publicDir }));
        app.get('*', serveStatic({ path: path.join(options.publicDir, 'index.html') }));
    }
    app.onError((error, c) => {
        if (error instanceof CatalogError)
            return c.json({ error: { code: error.code, message: error.message } }, error.status);
        if (preparations && /^\/api\/(?:answers|prepared-answers|question-preparations)(?:\/|$)/.test(c.req.path)) {
            const question = preparedQuestionError(error);
            if (question)
                return c.json({ error: { code: question.code, message: question.message } }, question.status);
        }
        const native = nativeCaptureError(error);
        if (native)
            return c.json({ error: native.error }, native.status);
        if (error instanceof OperationBudgetError) {
            const message = error.code === 'CANCELLED' ? 'The path request was cancelled.'
                : error.code === 'CAPTURE_TIME_LIMIT' ? 'The path request reached its time limit.'
                    : error.code === 'CAPTURE_WORK_LIMIT' ? 'The path request reached its work limit.' : undefined;
            if (message)
                return c.json({ error: { code: error.code, message } }, 409);
        }
        console.error(`LoreDock request failed (${error.name}).`);
        return c.json({ error: { message: 'The local operation failed. Check the daemon and retry.' } }, 500);
    });
    return app;
}
